function.description: Move an existing appointment to a new day or time. The tool decides whether a change fee applies — you do not. State the fee it returns, in full, before confirming, and only set feeAcknowledged once the caller has agreed.
function.name: rescheduleAppointment

bookingRef.description: Booking reference exactly as it was given to you, e.g. bk-3QR9.

feeAcknowledged.description: Set true only after you have stated the change fee and the caller agreed. Never assume agreement.

newDate.description: Local date in YYYY-MM-DD. Today or later. Never guess a year the caller did not say.

newTimePreference.description: Rough time of day the caller asked for. Use 'any' if they did not say.

messages.content: Let me look at that for you.
I'm having trouble changing that appointment.
